description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Honoured Companions — COMPANION'S WATCH (WP-C46): while a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is within range of an objective, that unit's attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1. Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2); setup: P1 detachment Honoured Companions, CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation, seeded dice, Custodian Guard Beta (TRUSTED SENTINEL) moved out of the melee onto objective No Man's Land 2 (y=1440 px, 3.3" clear of the Gretchin), then the Shooting phase is re-entered. Shooting phase: a real click selects Custodian Guard Beta, Quick-Assign at the Gretchin, Confirm, resolve: the ranged wound block's modifier ledger and the Dice Log name 'Companion's Watch (Honoured Companions)' (re-roll wound rolls of 1).

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description); the shooter stands within range of an objective marker, unengaged
steps.comment2: the Shooting phase is re-entered so its shooter list sees the new position
